_comment: Between-innings (run-only) upgrades bought in the dugout with run coins. price grows by price_growth per purchase.

upgrades.name: Faster Relay
upgrades.text: +10% attack speed and +10% throw speed for the whole team.

upgrades.name: New Pitch Card
upgrades.text: Choose one of three new ability cards to add to your deck for this run.

upgrades.name: Base Shield
upgrades.text: +1 home plate shield. Each shield turns a scoring runner into an out.

upgrades.name: Captain's Rally
upgrades.text: Your captain's aura grows: +8% damage to allies and +1.5m radius.

upgrades.name: Lucky Bat
upgrades.text: +6% critical hit chance for the whole team.

upgrades.name: Deep Pockets
upgrades.text: +20% coins from outs for the rest of the run.

upgrades.name: Card Mastery
upgrades.text: A random card in your deck gains +1 level for this run.

upgrades.name: Hot Streak
upgrades.text: One defender gains +25% damage for the rest of the run.

upgrades.name: Scouting Report
upgrades.text: Runners have 8% less health for the rest of the run.

upgrades.name: Quick Draw
upgrades.text: Cards are drawn 20% faster and card cooldowns are 10% shorter.
